title: Entering a soft subgraph node pauses before the first child
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads an inline graph whose only root is a subgraph (soft call site). One `graph_walk` step enters the call frame and stops before the child's first node — no child runner has executed yet. A following step runs the first child. Tracks SG-05[^sg-soft].
implementation: `GraphExecutor._enter_subgraph_node` on `one_step` when the frontier is a subgraph; parent stays `RUNNING` with `entered`; child checkpointed under `run_id:node_id`.
